facts.text: I am looking for new vegetarian recipes to try out.
I started taking a weekly cooking class at a local culinary school that focuses on vegetarian cuisine about a month ago.
I have been getting into cooking lately.
I am interested in exploring Indian-inspired dishes.
I made an Indian-inspired feast in my cooking class last week.
I am particularly interested in trying out Vegetable Korma.
I am a big fan of coconut milk-based sauces.
I want to add tofu to make the recipe more substantial.
I asked whether adding tofu would work well in the Vegetable Korma recipe.
I asked whether I can use coconut oil instead of regular oil for cooking the tofu and the vegetables.
I am going to try using coconut oil.
I will use a mild version of coconut oil and not too much of it.
